originality.rationale: The path counting sequence and rational generating function were not located in source and equivalence searches. The closest published path results give only extremal sizes; the closest forest generating function covers all super-dominating sets, not their inclusion-minimal subfamily. A general maximal open-irredundance criterion is an important precursor but does not enumerate the path configurations. Historical priority remains provisional because some full historical sources were not accessible. The cycle prior work has the same unweighted characteristic denominator; no novelty is claimed for that denominator alone, only the exact path-boundary numerator and its all-order interpretation.

value.rationale: The theorem provides a closed rational generating function and a short integral recurrence for the complete number of inclusion-minimal super-dominating configurations of every path order. This motivated configuration count is not determined by extrema, general definitions or total all-set counts and supports reproducible enumeration at arbitrary path length; it does not purport to solve a broader tree-classification problem.
